description: This file defines a controller class 'PurgeEmployeeController' within the OrangeHRM HR management system. The controller manages the 'purge employee' functionality in the maintenance plugin, setting up components for the front-end Vue.js interface and handling access control logic for administrative privileges.

classes.name: PurgeEmployeeController
classes.description: Controller managing the purge employee feature, extending abstract Vue.js controller and incorporating access control traits.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets up the Vue component for the purge employee interface, injecting configuration properties.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request, checking if the user has admin access and forwarding if necessary, otherwise proceeds with default handling.
